meta.title: Short Drama Studio
meta.description: The sidebar is configuration only: storyboard rules and download folder. Gemini connects automatically (detects saved keys, pulls models from the API, paste-once key saved to the credential store). The Xiaoyunque (pippit-tool-cli) / Jimeng (dreamina) CLIs are auto-detected, their models auto-listed, login status checked, and each can be updated from the panel. storyboard_write splits a long script into ordered storyboards written as NNN.md into a configurable folder; video_submit uses number to generate videos 1:1 with the storyboards and names them with the same number. Jimeng generation uses its flagship all-around reference mode (multimodal2video), auto-scanning workspace materials into repeatable --image/--video/--audio flags with model-based limits; Xiaoyunque is unchanged. Other agent tools: storyboard_list, short_drama_assets, video_status, video_download, video_cancel, all rooted at the current workspace.
